<!-- pr-reviewer: 636518a0a79016dbfb13c9d2c098faf3da2a17d1 -->

**Verdict: Not built - needs a maintainer look.** The review read the diff and the changed files. This is an outside contributor PR, so no CI runner or local build was authorized for it.

**What looks good**

- The importer now accepts a bounded, validated subset of empty `*Model_Space` / `*Paper_Space<N>` layout wrappers and empty DICTIONARY trees, and refuses everything else with a named diagnostic. No silent wrong geometry: the BLOCKS/OBJECTS readers add nothing to the `Document`, and the new first test pins that the imported document is equal with and without these records.
- Refusals cover block body geometry, `INSERT`, proxy and group-102 data, zero or duplicate handles, dangling or multi-owner dictionary targets, and cyclic ownership. Layout-name matching (`crates/geometry/src/dxf/blocks.rs:16`) rejects non-layout and malformed names.
- Every loop consumes at least one record per iteration; wrapper, record and entry counts are capped by `max_entities`; the ownership-chain walk (`crates/geometry/src/dxf/dictionaries.rs:104`) is iterative and marks each node once, so there is no recursion and no quadratic blowup. Handle parsing (`crates/geometry/src/dxf/pairs.rs:172`) is overflow-safe (max 16 hex digits).
- Laws check: no `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic` outside tests; both new modules and the new test file carry provenance lines; the test sits in `crates/geometry/tests` (the lowest crate that provides its imports) with a Gate map line; `docs/decisions/3176-inert-dxf-sections.md` is present; no new crate dependency; all files under 400 lines; commit subject is conventional and ends `Fixes #3176`; the body has a `Changelog:` line; no process files, goldens or snapshot PNGs touched.

**Results**

- Not built in this review (fork PR; no runner build authorized). GitHub reports the head mergeable with `main` (`MERGEABLE`).
- The author's run, cited in the body on this head (`636518a0a`), base `5e76e6a1`: quick gate 1,038 steps green, strict clippy on geometry targets, and the reached heavy gate (236 motion and application steps) green. This review did not re-run them.
- Heavy lanes: the diff reaches the `app`/`motion` heavy lanes through `camcraft-geometry`; the author's body names a green heavy run on the exact head. Not independently verified.

**Requested before merge**

1. A maintainer (or an authorized build slot) should run the quick gate plan and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-geometry --all-targets -- -D warnings` on this head, since this review could not build it.

**Questions / notes (not blocking)**

- `layout_name` does not trim group-2 values (`crates/geometry/src/dxf/blocks.rs:16-26`). A `BLOCK_RECORD` whose group 2 has trailing whitespace is skipped silently, while the matching `BLOCK` wrapper is refused with a diagnostic. Nothing wrong is imported; consider a shared trim so both sides agree.
- A dictionary that declares owner `330` = 0 and is also an entry target is refused ("entry target names a different owner", `crates/geometry/src/dxf/dictionaries.rs:112`). The decision entry names the "owner omitted" form. Confirm the explicit-null-owner form is a deliberate refusal.
- OBJECTS accepts only DICTIONARY records; real AutoCAD templates also carry ACDBDICTIONARYWDFLT and friends, which still give a named refusal. That matches the issue scope and is left to #1865.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
